verdict.rationale: Kit exposes some deliverability signals. These include account-level bounce rates over the last 90 days, a `subscriber.bounced` webhook event, and DMARC/verification status for sending addresses. However, its per-broadcast stats list only recipients, opens, clicks, and unsubscribes, with no per-send bounce metric. missing for 10: per-send bounce breakdown, spam complaint signals, blocklist monitoring, actionable guidance or alerts when deliverability degrades, independent corroboration.
